paragraphs: The well-known R' Yitzchak bar Nappacha.
R' Yochanan was likewise called “son of the smith”; see their entries.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source has בר. נפחא with an internal period; the English reads the connected patronymic and relocates the stop for intelligibility without changing Hebrew. Older machine .בר places the mark differently, so its printed position and origin are not newly settled. Smith is a lexical translator gloss of נפחא, not an independently established occupation.

The well-known qualifier remains attached to Yitzchak. Likewise, was called, and plural see-their-entries preserve the second notice’s force; the two named figures are not merged, and the destinations are not independently checked. Both title abbreviations remain R'.
